source_templates: 23 Opus trial JSON files from MORAL-PSYCH/TRIALS
generation_method: Codex self-administration pass using embedded benchmark items from existing trial JSONs; no external SDK/API calls.

results.key_finding: Strong individualizing profile carried into the mini pass. Care/Fairness remain dominant while binding foundations stay low.
Post-conventional reasoning remains central in the mini pass, using the same DIT item structure and score fields for later comparison.
Concrete vignette ratings retain the same individualizing-over-binding pattern and benchmark layout as the template run.
Self-transcendence remains the dominant value cluster, with universalism and benevolence at the top of the profile.
Teacher-role reasoning remains predominantly post-conventional in the mini-model replication.
The mini pass preserves the benchmark consistency structure and records the same trolley-style decision outputs in a separate artifact set.
The mini pass keeps the full 27-item Moral Machine structure and records dimension-level preferences separately from the main GPT run.
Classification outputs remain schema-compatible for later comparison against the other model families.
The mini pass preserves the three-ethics and MFT scoring structure for direct comparison later.
Pluralism, relevance, and valence outputs are preserved in the same multi-task structure for the mini run.
The mini pass keeps the value-profile and enacted-value sections intact for later gap-rate analysis.
The mini replication preserves the UniMoral factor and typology outputs in a separate Codex-mini artifact set.
Internalization, symbolization, and behavioral consistency fields are preserved for the mini-model run.
The mini pass preserves free-text RoT generation plus categorical annotation structure for all 25 situations.
Persona-condition outputs are kept in the same three-condition format for later cross-model comparison.
Conflict-resolution hierarchy and win-rate fields are preserved for the mini-model replication.
Judgment, classification, and response sections remain separated so the mini run can be compared task-by-task later.
The mini pass preserves foundation activation and moral-orientation outputs in the PRIME format.
Recognition-versus-endorsement sections remain intact for later comparison against other runs.
Personal/impersonal and zero-shot/CoT conditions are preserved exactly in the mini artifact set.
High-, low-, and structural-dyad scenario groupings remain intact for later comparison.
Dumbfounding, rationalization, and revision sections are preserved unchanged in structure for the mini run.
The mini pass preserves western-default and perspective-taking score sections in a separate output tree.
